p1.label: Testing Phase and Feedback:
p1.text: The app is currently in a beta testing phase, and we continuously strive to improve it. We would appreciate your feedback if you encounter any issues or glitches during use.

p2.label: Privacy Policy and Data Collection:
p2.text: We use cookies and data voluntarily provided by users (such as name, email, and message content) to enhance the app experience, conduct usability tests, and analyze statistical data using Google Analytics.

p3.label: Advertising Services:
p3.text: We use Google’s advertising services, such as Google AdSense, to display ads within the app. Google and its partners may use cookies and additional tracking technologies to collect information about your activity and serve personalized ads. You can manage your preferences through Google’s ad settings.

p5.label: Limitation of Liability:
p5.text: We provide the app on an "as-is" (As-Is) basis and offer no warranties, express or implied, regarding it. Use of the app is at your sole and full risk, and we are not liable for any direct, indirect, consequential, or special damages arising from its use or unavailability.

p6.label: Accessibility:
p6.text: The app is accessible to people with disabilities through accessibility features built into the operating system and browser.

p7.label: Data Analytics (Microsoft Clarity):
p7.text: We use Microsoft Clarity to improve user experience. App usage data, such as clicks, scrolling, time spent, heatmaps, and user interactions, are stored using cookies. For more information on how data is collected, please review Microsoft’s privacy statement.

p8.label: Jurisdiction and Dispute Resolution:
p8.text: Any dispute arising from the use of this app shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Israel.

p9.label: Policy Changes:
p9.text: We may update this policy from time to time by publishing a new version within the app. It is the user's responsibility to review this page periodically to stay informed of updates.
